versions.changelog: Ledger storage: prompt text is never stored, only compact preference summaries (key + ≤120-char excerpt). All data in one user-level directory, refused inside the project. Adds forget and preview-first migrate for pre-1.1 inboxes. Package reduced to 3 files; removed author-specific path rule.
Authenticate Inbox evidence with project-external trust state; auto-sign new hook events; require explicit digest migration for legacy events; preserve existing preference-memory behavior.

Installer integrity hardening: verify any existing project-local engine against the bundled SHA-256 before emitting executable hook snippets; stop on mismatch and replace only with explicit --force. Includes external digest-bound myprofile trust.

Security hardening: myprofile trust requires explicit approval and a SHA-256 record stored outside the project; project-local trust stores are rejected and any profile edit invalidates trust. Preserves conservative prompt filtering and cross-agent preference sync.

Security hardening: bind myprofile trust to an explicitly approved SHA-256 stored outside the project; invalidate trust after edits; preserve conservative prompt filtering and add the confirmed non-document storage preference.

Security hardening: only preference-like prompts are retained, sensitive prompts are skipped, unknown free-form directives stay pending, legacy unsafe events are filtered, and setup is preview-first with explicit opt-in.
Initial release: local cross-agent preference memory, secret redaction, context injection, and safe setup helper.
